result.instructions: Tools for Atlassian Jira, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which issues are assigned to me and still open?"; "Show the open bugs in project PROJ created this week."; "What changed on PROJ-123 in the last three days?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Atlassian Jira data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run jira_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run jira_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run jira_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. jira_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: jira_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: Return the signed-in Jira user (accountId, name, email, time zone). Jira: GET /myself.

tools.name: jira_find_users
tools.title: Find users
tools.description: Search users by name or email fragment. Returns accountId values for other tools. Jira: GET /user/search.

tools.name: jira_search_issues
tools.title: Search issues
tools.description: Search issues with JQL (for example "project = PROJ AND status = 'In Progress'"). Returns one page plus nextPageToken. Default fields: summary, status, assignee, priority, issuetype, project, updated, labels. Jira: POST /search/jql.

fields.description: Issue fields to return. Default: summary, status, assignee, priority, issuetype, project, updated, labels.

tools.name: jira_get_issue
tools.title: Get issue
tools.description: Return one issue with its fields (summary, status, assignee, priority, description). Jira: GET /issue/{issueIdOrKey}.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue key (for example PROJ-123) or numeric issue id.

fields.description: Issue fields to return, for example ["summary","status"]. Default: all navigable fields.

tools.name: jira_get_issue_comments
tools.title: Get issue comments
tools.description: List the comments on an issue. Jira: GET /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/comment.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue key (for example PROJ-123) or numeric issue id.

tools.name: jira_get_issue_transitions
tools.title: Get issue transitions
tools.description: List the workflow transitions open for an issue now (use the id with jira_transition_issue). Jira: GET /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/transitions.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue key (for example PROJ-123) or numeric issue id.

tools.name: jira_get_issue_changelog
tools.title: Get issue changelog
tools.description: List the change history of an issue (who changed which field, and when). Jira: GET /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/changelog.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue key (for example PROJ-123) or numeric issue id.

tools.name: jira_get_issue_worklogs
tools.title: Get issue worklogs
tools.description: List the time-tracking worklogs on an issue. Jira: GET /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/worklog.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue key (for example PROJ-123) or numeric issue id.

tools.name: jira_search_projects
tools.title: Search projects
tools.description: List projects, optionally filtered by a name or key fragment. Jira: GET /project/search.

tools.name: jira_get_project
tools.title: Get project
tools.description: Return one project (key, name, lead, issue types). Jira: GET /project/{projectIdOrKey}.

projectIdOrKey.description: Project key (for example PROJ) or numeric project id.

tools.name: jira_get_project_statuses
tools.title: Get project statuses
tools.description: List the statuses used by each issue type in one project. Jira: GET /project/{projectIdOrKey}/statuses.

projectIdOrKey.description: Project key (for example PROJ) or numeric project id.

tools.name: jira_list_fields
tools.title: List fields
tools.description: List all system and custom fields with their ids (use these ids in the fields parameters). Jira: GET /field.

tools.name: jira_list_priorities
tools.title: List priorities
tools.description: List the issue priorities (names and ids) of the site. Jira: GET /priority/search.

projectId.description: Limit to one project's priority scheme.

tools.name: jira_list_issue_types
tools.title: List issue types
tools.description: List the issue types the signed-in user can see (Bug, Task, Story, and so on). Jira: GET /issuetype.

tools.name: jira_list_statuses
tools.title: List statuses
tools.description: List all workflow statuses of the site. Jira: GET /status.

tools.name: jira_get_my_filters
tools.title: Get my filters
tools.description: List the saved filters owned by the signed-in user; with includeFavourites, also their favourite filters. Jira: GET /filter/my.

tools.name: jira_create_issue
tools.title: Create issue
tools.description: WRITE: create one issue in a project. Plain-text description. Jira: POST /issue. Only creates; does not edit or delete.

projectKey.description: Project key (for example PROJ) or numeric project id.

issueTypeName.description: Issue type name, for example Task or Bug.

tools.name: jira_add_comment
tools.title: Add comment
tools.description: WRITE: add one plain-text comment to an issue. Jira: POST /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/comment. Does not edit or delete comments.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue key (for example PROJ-123) or numeric issue id.

tools.name: jira_transition_issue
tools.title: Transition issue
tools.description: WRITE: move an issue to a new status by transition id (from jira_get_issue_transitions). Jira: POST /issue/{issueIdOrKey}/transitions.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue key (for example PROJ-123) or numeric issue id.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Atlassian Jira
prompts.description: What you can do with Atlassian Jira here, with example requests to try.

prompts.name: see_your_open_work
prompts.title: See your open work
prompts.description: Get the signed-in user, then search issues with JQL, such as the open issues assigned to you.

prompts.name: review_what_changed_on_an_issue
prompts.title: Review what changed on an issue
prompts.description: Read an issue with its fields, then its change history and its comments.

prompts.name: check_the_workflow_of_a_project
prompts.title: Check the workflow of a project
prompts.description: Read a project, list the statuses of each issue type, and list the transitions open for one issue.

prompts.name: create_a_new_issue
prompts.title: Create a new issue
prompts.description: List the issue types, then create one issue in a project with a plain-text description. The tool only creates; it does not edit or delete.

prompts.name: move_an_issue_and_explain_the_change
prompts.title: Move an issue and explain the change
prompts.description: Get the transitions open for an issue, move it to the new status, then add a plain-text comment.
